objective: After the controlled maintenance drill, measure ordinary first-to-100 boxing. Scoring counts every accepted hit including a damage upgrade. Always show the separate maintenance metric from K3, K5 and K10. Full-bout score is secondary to the established-combo drill.
setup: Flat main-lab boxing court, six-block gap, no opening handicap, MMC v2, 20 CPS, normal 3-block reach, identical reaction and tracking, 0/0 and 80/80 ms, both seats. A draw at the native 180-second limit earns half credit. Compare W-tap, Hold-W, the frozen maintenance specialist and the population sumo reference. The specialist uses the same live two-second/no-earlier start for counting local hurt cues and W-tap until release. Report native handoff timing against the true damage events.
panel: Against W-tap and Hold-W, two independent repeats per seat/RTT/arm. Model on the next new human-sparring donor panel after all four fighters were frozen. Use actual native rounds to check transfer. No promotion of a boxing maintenance specialist from full-match wins alone.
